lines: appinfo/info.xml states no <repository>.

<repository> is the only machine-readable link from a published release back to the source it was built from, and <bugs> is where the App Store page sends a report. Without them a user of the release has no way back to the project.
Declares Nextcloud 15 to 17; the oldest maintained major is 32 (as of 2026-09), the newest released 35 (the release tags of nextcloud/server).
max-version 17 is below the oldest maintained major (32, as of 2026-09), so the release covers only servers that no longer receive fixes.
min-version 15 reaches below the oldest maintained major (32), which means the code has to keep working with APIs that are no longer tested upstream.
A link of appinfo/info.xml has moved permanently:
<bugs> http://todo.cz
now https://www.todo.cz/
The old address works only as long as the redirect is kept; the new one can be stated directly.
No Node version is stated: no engines.node, no .nvmrc, and no node-version in the installed workflows.
Whoever builds the app uses whatever Node they have, and a build that works on one machine is then not evidence for the next.
Tooling in the checkout: none of the configurations this audit looks for.
No ESLint configuration: nothing checks the frontend sources, so a wrong import is found by the build or not at all.
No Stylelint configuration: stylesheets are unchecked, and a mistake in CSS fails silently instead of loudly.
No Psalm configuration: the PHP side has no static analysis, which is what catches a wrong type before the server does.
No PHPUnit configuration: there is no test harness in the checkout, so nothing can be run against a change.
No PHP-CS-Fixer configuration: no coding standard is applied to the PHP sources, so formatting is settled in review instead of by a command.
No REUSE configuration: licensing is not machine-checkable, which the App Store and every distribution ask for.
No EditorConfig configuration: indentation is whatever each contributor's editor does.
Licence agpl (appinfo/info.xml).
agpl in appinfo/info.xml is a deprecated App Store value, shown there as AGPLv3+, which is AGPL-3.0-or-later. An SPDX id there needs a <nextcloud> min-version of 31 or higher.
No LICENSES/ directory, so the licence text itself is not in the checkout, which is what REUSE and the distributions check for.
The ncmake bootstrap stub is in place (21 lines).
Every directory the shipped PHP reaches through __DIR__ and the frontend through linkTo is in the shipped file set (the ncmake core and ncmake.mk).
